_comment: Single source for the video tutorials shown in the app Help dialog and on the website (website/_build/build.py reads this file and generates tutorials.html and tutorial/<id>/). youtubeId is the 11-character video id (the build also accepts a full YouTube URL). chapters are [seconds, title] pairs (first one at 0). The poster image is website/assets/images/tutorials/<id>.jpg.
